items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: I'm mailing some things to Bob Stewart and Howard Johnson. That's for five tubas and alto saxophone, flugelhorn and trombone and keyboards. I think it's going to be performed on September 20th

ctx.x: As a matter of fact, when I leave here today, I'm mailing some things to Bob Stewart and Howard Johnson. That's for five tubas and alto saxophone, flugelhorn and trombone and keyboards. I think it's going to be performed on September 20th, I don't know where, but in New York.
That should be interesting to hear.
